items.title: Hema-kn-git/ML-Powered-Multi-Modal-System-for-Early-Detection-of-Alzheimer-s-Disease: Built a machine learning system for early detection of Alzheimer's Disease using multimodal analysis, combining imaging and clinical data for improved diagnostic accuracy. ● Applied ML techniques including classification and feature extraction to identify early-stage biomarkers across multiple data modalities.
